text: ＊は　かなしばりで　＊が　だせない！

patterns.name: 〜で (cause)
patterns.explanation: で after a thing can give the reason for what follows. かなしばりで = 'because of Disable'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: だす 'put out' becomes だせる 'can put out', and ない makes it 'cannot'. だせない = 'can't use it'.
